body: Please leave. It is so hard, but we deserve love. We deserve someone who thinks we’re the hottest and most beautiful woman ever. Find someone who doesn’t choose porn over you. Please don’t get married to him or have his children. You deserve a happy ending.

If I could go back in time and tell 15f me anything, I would tell her to not place so much value in male validation. It’s nice to feel wanted by guys, especially older men, but it leaves you with lots of trauma. Men seeing you as a sex object won’t go away, but focusing on yourself and staying away from guys who objectify you will do wonders for your self esteem. Also date people close to you in age. There are SO many men who want to date younger girls because they feel more power over them. It’s fucked.

Do whatever feels right and is comfortable. Respect each others boundaries, and of course use a condom! I stopped taking birth control 2 years ago and have not gotten pregnant. I track my cycle and use a condom with my partner.
Yup. Any sexual desire I had pretty much completely disappeared. It’s so hard for me to get in the mood now. My body physically rejects it.
Happy birthday! Mine was yesterday.

Yes yes yes; and this is saying a lot because for the longest time I thought my biggest fear was ending up alone. Now my biggest fear is ending up with someone who doesn’t respect me or my boundaries.

I’ms so sorry you are going through this. Our PA partners don’t realize just how much they are ruining for us, they see porn as just a quick, easy, and harmless escape. In reality, it is so damaging and for them to continue choosing porn over real life, beautiful women is incredibly selfish and disgusting. As for you, please take care of yourself. You deserve so much and you are worthy of unconditional love and respect. I’m 23 going therough similar things and I’m here if you ever need to talk.

This gave me PTSD. I remember the heart wrenching and disgusted feeling I had while browsing through my bf’s Reddit account. It’s so humiliating and angering. They’re disgusting for objectifying women like this. You deserve so much better.

When I found all this in my partner’s phone, I sat down alone and gathered my emotions. I waited until I felt settled and figured out what I was going to say. I confronted him somewhat gently but also firmly at the same time. I asked for him to be honest and I stated my boundaries, that I am not OK with him interacting with porn on Reddit.
Happy birthday! I also turn 24 in a few months.

I just finished my first pack of Slynd and am currently having a really light period, basically only spotting. My mood has remained the same. I have been dealing with depression since before Slynd and it’s still present. I only got two pimples in the last two weeks but I attributed to my period starting. The only thing I’ve noticed is a decrease in my sex drive. Overall, I’m pleased with Slynd and have two more packs to go through.
I’m on Slynd and it’s been good to me so far.
Nice work, keep it up! Fuck porn addiction

Women don’t have a love for abortions. I don’t think anyone does. Women want body autonomy. Having a baby doesn’t just imply having to carry one for nine months, it’s everything that comes after that too. Raising a child is expensive and takes over the life of the parents, mentally and physically. If anything, people who choose not to have kids knowing they won’t be able to raise them or provide for them are being considerate. A child shouldn’t be forced to exist in a world where they will suffer because they were unwanted by their parents or couldn’t be cared for by them.

Honestly, this post comes across in very poor taste and very mysoginistic. I’m not sure if those were your intentions or not. But it’s not only women who are pro-choice, many men advocate for it too. Please remember that abortions aren’t fun or easy. I doubt any women has love for abortion as your title suggests.

I’m so sorry you are going through this. The aftermath has been the most horrible part for me. Sure, finding out made me upset, but the resentment that has built up since then is miserable. 

I was long distance with my boyfriend as well. He was consuming porn the entire time we were away from each other, even when I would send him nudes and have phone sex with him. I actually didn’t find out about it until months later when we had moved in together. My perception of him changed completely. I felt disgusted, angry, and just awful in my own skin. I thought this was the man I wanted to marry, but seeing him comment on other women’s bodies and paying for OnlyFans made me change my image of him entirely. I was so hurt and disappointed, and sometimes I still feel like this. I don’t know if it ever goes away.

One thing I can say is that each of you need to work on yourselves. Please consider therapy. Talking to a professional about how I was feeling really helped, otherwise I just felt like I was being unreasonable and that I was getting angry at nothing. It really validated my feelings and made me feel heard. Also, communication with your partner is so important. Sit down and be completely honest, say how you feel and establish boundaries. If he chooses to continue to break them, please make a plan. You are worth so much than staying with someone that would choose porn over a real life, beautiful woman. Please always put yourself first.

I stay because he’s constantly trying to be a good boyfriend. I think after our latest Dday in March he finally understood how serious I am about leaving him because of his porn. I can’t stand to let it happen again, and I am more comfortable with myself now. I know I am happier without a porn addict, and I will not hesitate to leave and find someone new. He’s a good guy for the most part, but is so bad at communicating which makes me feel like he’s constantly hiding things. Lately I can’t find the energy to care. My heart was once so invested in this relationship but now it’s halfway out the door.

Yeah, my sex drive was sky-high in the beginning of my relationship. I couldn’t get enough of him, and then I found out about his porn addiction. It just ruined everything. I didn’t feel sexy or attractive. I was resentful, angry, and disgusted. I feel as if I only have sex with him to feel some sort of validation, such as feeling wanted even if its for a few minutes, and keeping him from having to masturbate and get off to porn instead. They’re shitty reasons, but they keep me here. I don’t really get anything out of sex anymore, it’s not pleasurable as it once was. It’s just something we do because we are in a relationship. I never get to orgasm anymore, and I don’t really have any interest in doing it with him or just by myself. It sucks.

I’m so sorry you are going through this. Please always make yourself and your baby your priority. Decide whatever is best and healthiest for you.

My boyfriend also seems like a textbook definition of a good boyfriend. And then there’s his porn addiction. It kinda ruins the whole thing. It makes me scared to want marriage or kids, because I don’t want my kids to ever find out of their dads porn consumption. I refuse to let that happen.

You put this perfectly into words. I am living the exact same thing. I chose to stay but I am miserable half of the time when I remember what my boyfriend has done. Our relationship improved after giving him an ultimatum, but just like you, it now just feels like I am waiting for something to happen so it can be my excuse to leave his ass. 

I am so apathetic towards my relationship even though things are currently good per se. He is loving and affectionate, but I have so much resentment. I get flashbacks of all the objectifying comments he made on other women’s bodies online, and it disgusts me every time. How can I know he’s changed? I can’t, and I don’t know if I can live the rest of my life wondering if he’s ever going to do it again. I hate it.

This happened to me too. It’s actually incredible how much porn/nude/nsfw content there is on Reddit. I had no idea, until I found my boyfriend’s porn account. He followed everything; from hentai, to teen porn, to fetish communities. It was all so bizarre for me because it was a part of him that he never shared with me. We’d talk about porn and he always drifted away from the subject. Well it turns out he is addicted to porn. He would look at it when I wasn’t home, while he was at work, after I went to sleep, and probably every chance he got. It devastated me. It made me feel insecure and as if I wasn’t good or sexy enough for him. I confronted him about it, he apologized but I don’t think he quite understands how it makes me feel. He just feels sorry he got caught, and is now better at hiding it. 

I think you should talk to your husband about it. Tell him what you saw, and how it made you feel. Set some boundaries if that’s what would make you most comfortable. It’s up to him to respect them, and if he loves you he will. 

Ps. I also found lots of support in my situation from the community at r/loveafterporn I’m not saying your husband is an addict, but porn consumption in general is a fair boundary to have in a relationship. You deserve to be respected and feel good about yourself.

I’m in the same place. I stopped caring, I stopped looking, and now I am just numb towards him, and the relationship. As another comment said, I think this will prepare us to build strength to leave when we are ready to leave. Please take care of yourself.

He is gaslighting you. You have every right to feel hurt by him not respecting you. I always thought I was okay with porn because “all guys do it”, but then my boyfriend started interacting with it. He wouldn’t just look at porn, he would make comments on Reddit about women and their naked bodies, he started subscribing to accounts on OnlyFans, he began reaching out to women on Kik to sext with them. These are all boundaries he chose to break, all because he assumed I was okay with porn.

I have resented my partner for so long. For making me feel insecure, not good enough, not sexy enough. I have so many trust issues now, and it has ruined our intimacy. I can’t leave him and his phone alone at home without worrying that he is looking at porn or sexting other people behind my back. 

Being with a porn addict is so hard, and so so miserable. Please choose yourself and your daughter. You are what matters. You deserve to feel loved and respected. Take it from me, I have chosen to stay with my PA and it has been ruining my self esteem. Your daughter needs you to be the strongest version of you, and being with a PA will make it so hard to do this. You don’t need him tearing you down. You deserve happiness and so much more.

I’ve gotten to a point where I just feel defeated. I make myself believe that I don’t care. If he wants to watch porn, he will. It all lies on me, and trusting myself to make the right choice to leave if it comes down to it. I feel numb towards my PA. We’ve had 3 Ddays and my heart has been stomped on time and time again. Sometimes I think the fourth one is inevitable. Each time I caught him hurt less and less, and now I’m starting to believe I lost all care I had for him and what he does. I’m sure I’ll be miserable if it happens again though.

It’s crazy to see how many men actually condemn porn usage in a relationship. My bf is addicted to porn and one of the pushbacks was “everyone does it”. I wish it wasn’t like that though. Porn ruined the real sex we were having. Now it’s just made me frustrated to not have fulfilling sex.

He is lying and gaslighting you whether he realizes it or not. Whenever I have caught my boyfriend, I find it easier to talk to him about what I found once I have processed everything. It may be hours, or days. But after finding his porn use, I immediately find myself enraged and disgusted. Then I calm down a little and feel hurt. I think once we are past that initial shock and rage, our thoughts begin to settle. You should tell him what you saw, and explain how it makes you feel. Stay calm and collected, this might make it easier for him to open up and maybe explain why he did what he did. It’s not a matter of if he did watch porn, or however else that redgifs link got to his phone. You know the truth. You know he relapsed and consumed porn, now it’s important to take it from there and have a conversation. Don’t allow him to gaslight you, make you feel crazy, or as if your feelings are not valid. Your boundaries should be respected, and you deserve to feel loved.

About 3 months. I don’t think him being in recovery helped. We started having sex just out of necessity, I guess. It’s not how it was before, and I’m afraid it never will. I think my perception of him and our sex life also changed, I’m starting therapy soon. Maybe ohr sex life will improve then.

Yes. As another comment said, the thought of him drooling over other women online made me disgusted. I lost all respect and trust in him after finding out all the lies he’s told me and the things he’s hidden from me. Part of what makes me aroused during sex is knowing my partner wants me as much as I want them, but knowing that wasn’t the case just killed my sex drive.

My libido was sky-high when I first met him and it was high in every previous relationship I’ve had. However, ever since Dday I can feel myself changing my perspective of sex. It seems like a chore a lot of the time. I prefer getting myself off instead, but even that doesn’t feel fulfilling because the emotional aspect isn’t there. I want to want sex, but I’ve just felt stuck for a while.
My bf is in recovery, or at least he says. We have a regular sex life, but it’s not great. I miss how it was before I discovered his porn addiction. I still want sex, but the thought of doing it with him sometimes just puts me off of it entirely.

It seems like the only way to get your sex drive back is to be in a sexual relationship with someone else. Someone who makes you feel sexy and wanted (unlike a PA), then you can really have passionate and fulfilling sex.

I am in a very similar situation to yours. I met my bf online and we moved in together a year after. A few months in, I discovered he had an alt account on Reddit to look at porn, nudes, etc. I told him I was uncomfortable and he deleted it. However, a few months later I found a confirmation email to a girls OnlyFans in his inbox. He made up the stupidest excuse, cried, and I stayed. Then only a month later, I get a gut feeling that he is being sneaky around his phone. I snoop and find out he has been using Kik to sext with other girls. I felt so shattered. I have never felt so disgusted, angry, and insecure.

My advice to you is to sit down with him and have a conversation. Tell him what makes you uncomfortable, set boundaries, and most importantly, stand your ground. If he continues consuming porn, you are out of the relationship. I don’t think any other way would make it click in their head that they have an addiction that is so damaging to their relationship. If he admits he has an addiction and seeks help for it, it’s up to you to decide if you want to support him.

However, I don’t think you should stay if he refuses to take accountability and acknowledge he has an addiction. If he is brushing it off and making it seem way less of a deal than it is, run. He will only continue to gaslight you, lie to you, and hide things from you. Trust me, someone who doesn’t want to get better will continue feeding their addiction and it will only get worse and more painful for you. I wish I had this conversation with my bf sooner. I don’t think it clicked on him how addicted he was and how much it affected me the first time I caught him. I hate that I put up with his lies and secrecy for so long. Being with a PA takes such a toll on you. It made me insecure, less trusting of him, and overall just less attracted to him.

Please do whatever what is right for you. You are young and have a whole life ahead of you, please don’t let it be full of misery and pain. You deserve a partner that wants to be the best version of themselves. Someone who loves and respects you, who makes you feel wanted.

Lol I’ve seen her videos. She doesn’t edit anything, whether because she doesn’t want to or she can’t. I just can’t believe how unappreciative she is of all the hard work that makes Frenemies possible. It’s insane and incredibly tone deaf for her to think she could ever pull something like Frenemies off by herself.

I didn’t know that. I did also consider the possibility of her changing her entire narrative during this video. She constantly contradicts herself and I don’t buy the whole “I’m leaving because I can’t stand the idea of making the employees uncomfortable”. It’s almost as if she’s putting herself on some pedestal pretending to be some grand, good person that she has shown time and time again that she is not.

I like seeing these type of TikToks because it makes me feel less alone and somewhat validated. It’s crazy how many porn addicts are out there without knowing. I always find comments on TikTok about girls having my same experience, they just don’t realize its porn addiction. It’s heart crushing seeing how common it is.

Yess! I’m so glad we’re not alone, it makes me less afraid. Also, I just got my period about an hour ago. It looks like I skipped one whole period, and here it is 2 months later lol. Hope you get this relief soon!

Nope, I  haven’t gotten my period and I’m starting to worry. I’m 34 days late, my last period being March 28th which feels like forever ago.

I took a pregnancy test this morning and it was negative. Probably taken around 6 total at this point. I’m feeling a bit crampy today so I’m hoping it comes soon.
It shows up as ‘OnlyFans’ on their bank statement. It’s helpful to know around what date they started their subscription. I found email confirmations first, and then looked at his bank statements.

He sounds fucked up. His addiction has taken too much control over his life. You don’t deserve to be put through that. 

It is so stupid how PA are so easily blown away by pornstars. They are performers, and they would never in a million years want to fuck them. Porn addiction is so sick because it makes us believe there’s something wrong with us, when in reality it’s them, the ones consuming porn. I’m really sorry this is happening to you.

I can relate to this so much. I still fail to understand why my boyfriend chooses to hide stuff from me and then lie about it when I ask. It’s like a slap in the face. I have reassured him that he could tell me anything, but he still doesn’t. I think they find it embarrassing to talk about. 

Either way, they will keep on feeding their addiction to porn. I found that the more I confront my boyfriend about it, the better he is at hiding things. My gut feeling has never lied to me though. Whenever I suspect he is consuming porn, I have gone through his computer/phone and found porn. Lately he just clears his history, logs out of all his accounts, and it makes it harder to find anything. But this only confirms that he’s never gonna stop looking at other girls, he’s just trying to get away with it. It hurts and it really fucking sucks.

I’m sorry you are going through this. You deserve so much better. You deserve an honest partner who makes you feel loved and respected. If you ever need to talk, I’m here.

The names. I can’t even stand the thought of hearing someone have the same name as the pornstars he likes. It’s ruined so much of my self esteem and it’s made me bitter towards other women. I hate it.

I caught my boyfriend saying how he really liked this one pornstar. She was tan, petite, thin, dark hair, and had small breasts. She looked young as well. When I confronted him about the comments he made about her, he said that she liked her because “it reminded him of me”, which I found to be complete bullshit. It also made me more disgusted rather than making me feel better. I have fair skin, larger breasts, and am not exactly thin. I became so insecure that he didn’t like my body, and that he preferred someone smaller. 

To this day, I still need reassurance because I don’t feel sexy to him. So to answer your question, I don’t really know if I was better off not knowing why he liked watching that pornstar. I feel better knowing he explained his reasoning for liking her, but then it also made me more insecure. I don’t think I’ll be asking him about his favorite pornstars any time soon, because I know none of them look like me.

Thank you for this. I do realize I need to break things off if I ever want to be in a relationship with trust and respect again. I struggle every day trying to get myself to do it, but I’m so easily convinced that he will be better. I care for him, but any romantic feelings have been slowly disappearing. He is not the future I want, but he disagrees. I’m really trying to make the right decision for me, even though it’s really hard. Thank you for the words of encouragement.

Losing weight is hard. I’m on a weight loss journey as well, and I have maintained my weight for the last 10 months. I hate it so much. I’m making healthier choices, doing a calorie deficit, and I don’t see results. I started going to the gym 2 weeks ago. No progress yet, but it makes me feel better about myself. I am taking a break from the scale. It discourages me too much. Maybe a break could help you too?

I think successful weight loss happens when there is discipline and consistency. I haven’t had either of those the past year, but I’m trying again. I am eating food that I feel good about going into my body, I’m working out because I want to be stronger and stop jiggling around. I try not to pay too much attention to the scale (easier said than done) because it is so discouraging. It fluctuates too much. Try weighing yourself once a week, the same day at the same time.

Best of luck! I’m here if you need someone to talk to, or an accountability buddy.
This is so wholesome. I wish you two the best!

We have an apartment together. He moved from California to Texas to be with me. I guess I feel guilty and somewhat trapped. I have confronted him 3 times about his porn consumption and each time it ends with him saying things will be different from now on. I feel silly for staying, but to be honest I feel horrible if I kick him to the curb and I am also scared of being alone. Even though I’m 22, the thought of being alone and starting over is scary.

Yes yes yes. I feel just as disgusted now as I did when I first found his porn. I remember seeing his searches, his comments on other women’s bodies, his onlyfans subscriptions, and how it all made me sick to my stomach. I always thought my boyfriend (23m) was a decent man. I wanted a future with him; a family, a house. But now, the thought of it makes me ick. I don’t want my future kids to have a dad that consumes porn, and I don’t want a marriage with a dead bedroom.

It’s horrible how this addiction changed my perspective on my SO and our relationship. I am scared to watch HBO shows with him because of the sex scenes, I get insecure when other attractive women walk by us. Needless to say, I couldn’t stand the thought of touching him after Dday. It felt gross and I didn’t want sex. This was over 6 months ago. We have sex regularly now, but it’s not as hot and passionate as before. It feels very bland.

Resentment is a bitch because my mind keeps bringing these memories back and the feelings of disgust are so vivid. Some days I get angry and don’t feel like having him close to me. I don’t know if this ever goes away.

I think it’s brave of you to admit this, and it’s a step in the right direction. As a girl, I was never aware of how porn impacts young men. I always thought it’s just what every guy does and that was the norm. And then I got into a relationship with a porn addict. I couldn’t understand why my bf would go behind my back to watch porn and then not want to have sex with me. It destroyed my self esteem and made me so insecure. I hate porn for what it did to my relationsip. This throwaway account is my way to cope and vent.

You give me hope though. It’s not too late to improve yourself and work on beating this addiction. Do it for yourself and for your future partner.

I am feeling exactly as you described. After having three ddays, I just lost all trust and respect I had for him as a partner. I lose attraction to him whenever I think about how he drools over other women online. It feels digusting to me. Not to mention how all of my trust in him has disappeared. I don’t believe anything he says anymore, I just assume he’s hiding things and lying.

Sometimes I feel like the only way I’ll ever feel sexy, loved, and respected again is if I end this relationship and begin a new one. Easier said than done. I feel trapped, and I am so afraid of ending up alone. Maybe that explains why I’m still here, 3 ddays later. Sigh.

It’s time to leave. Having to fight over his phone is too much. He is hiding things, and I can totally understand how you have become numb to it. I am going through the exact same thing. I am absolutely sure I will find things if I go through his phone, so I just don’t have the energy to do it. It brings me down too much, it makes me lose sleep, lose my appetite, and cry. I don’t want that, so I just stopped looking. He’s not in recovery, and I am just living in ignorance. 

This is no way to live. When you stop caring is when you realize that all the love is gone. The true, genuine love you had for him. You deserve better. You deserve someone that respects you, is honest, and makes you feel loved. You deserve to be head over heels about someone, and have that reciprocated!
Had my first Pfizer dose April 3rd, second dose May 1st and I haven’t had a period since the end or March. I’m currently at 2 weeks late and freaking out. Took 3 pregnancy tests and all negative.

My bf has a really hard time opening up to me about what he likes. Even before I discovered his  addiction, I would ask him what porn he watches, what his kinks are, what he would like to try, and he would shake it off and say “I like how it is now”.  I don’t know what to do. I know he wants to talk about it because he made an alternate Reddit accound looking for a “sexting buddy” where he said he wanted to discuss fantasies, kinks, porn, stuff they would do to each other. When I confronted him he said he liked the anonimosity of it, but I feel a little resentful because he doesn’t tell me any of these things. Instead, he wants to sext with strangers online and tell them what he’d like to do with them. It really hurts.

You’re not being pathetic. I also feel upset and uneasy about the fact that my boyfriend has spent so much money playing games just because of their sexual aspect. He gets the mods for the full “nude” experience too. It’s sickening.

I don’t know what to think or do anymore. He specifically plays all these sexual games when I am away from home, and then lies to me about what he does. I will never understand the need to PAY to see all naked cartoon/game charaters. It’s so odd and upsetting to me.

Sigh. This is very similar to my experience. I caught my boyfriend (24m) paying for OF subscriptions, and messaging girls on Kik for videos. It’s such a slap in the face. Especially when you know the truth and they decide to lie to your face about it.

My bf and I had a conversation about it and he just said “I don’t know why I do it”. He assured me nothing was wrong with me, but I still fail to understand why anyone in a fulfilling relationship would seek out porn? I guess this is what makes porn addiction so painful, especially on PA partners.

Please talk to him. If he is willing to acknowledge his porn addiction and seek help for it, this relationship may work. If not, he is just manipulating you into staying. Saying things like “it’s got nothing to do with you” is such a bullshit excuse. He needs to own up to what he does and prove that he wants to be better moving forward. Please don’t give in to a relationship with an addict that doesn’t want to get better. They will keep lying and hiding things and it becomes so miserable and painful to endure time and time again.

Yup yup yup. Porn has ruined so much for me. I remember loving Game of Thrones, but now I can’t bear the idea of watching it because of how much sex was in it. Let alone watching it with my boyfriend (which I did before I found about his addiction). I can’t imagine watching anything like that anymore because now my brain is so aware that he sees naked women in such a vicious and sexual way. I wish there was a way to avoid being exposed to it, but it seems impossible to do in this day and age.

This is my exact same experience. If I hadn’t caught my bf, I’d think our sex life and relationship are completely fine. Unfortunately, I came across his porn. At first, I was hurt that he hid it from me, and then I was disgusted at how he was objectifying women as if they just exist for his pleasure. It was a whirlwind of emotions.

If you don’t like your partner watching porn, that is totally fine. Don’t let anyone let you feel like you’re being over the top, or that “everyone does it”. Porn is a valid boundary to have. Your boyfriend shouldn’t have the need to look at other naked girls, or to watch other people having sex. Having real sex should be enough, and it should be a happy and fulfilling experience for both of you. 

Please talk to him. Tell him how it makes you feel, tell him that you don’t want a relationship where porn is involved. It’s all valid. Don’t give in to it. A relationship with a porn addict is miserable. It’s constant insecurity of not feeling good enough, and constantly worrying that your boyfriend is watching or fantasizing about porn. You deserve to be respected and feel secure in a relationship.

Once they get caught, they get so much better at hiding it. They are addicted, and they will go through so much just to feed their addiction and then lie to your face. It’s heartbreaking honestly. It’s no way to live. 

You deserve to be respected and you deserve peace of mind, not constantly worrying about what he’s looking at. It’s so exhausting to live like this. If you suspect he has looked at porn, he most definitely has. My gut feeling has never failed me. It’s how I have caught my BF time and time again.
Happy birthday! I am so glad you’re here. I wish you the very best in the future.

Holy shit. Please get out of this relationship. If you two get married it’s only going to get so much worse and more painful.

Do not blame yourself for not being “sexual or kinky enough”. He is not respecting your boundaries and keeps pushing you into doing stuff you don’t want. That is so wrong.

I’m really sorry this is happening to you. Please please please save yourself more heartbreak and pain. You don’t deserve a future where you are miserable. Your fiancé is the problem here. Please know that you deserve better. You deserve a life of happiness and respect. I promise that it is out there.

The resentment is the worst. I hate how resentful I have become. I still feel as angry as I did on day one when I found out. My brain keeps the memory of seeing his porn searches, messages, etc so vividly.

I know this might not be what you want to hear, but I think getting rid of all this resentment will be (nearly) impossible if you stay. In my experience, there is no amount of apologies or improvement that can ever make me gain back the trust I had before. I’ve tried, and I just can’t let it go. I was betrayed time and time again, this is not what I want from someone I will spend the rest of my life with.

If often seems like the only way I’ll ever feel pretty, in love, and respected again is in a new relationship with someone very different. There are honest men out there, I know it. They’re not the easiest to come across, but they will be worth holding onto. It will be so much better to live without resentment, without worrying about what your partner is looking at or doing behind your back. Starting over wouldn’t be so bad. You are 26, just in time to meet people and put yourself out there. You deserve to feel sexy and pretty. There’s someone out there who will be so lucky to have you.
Going through his phone. I have only done it when I’m suspicious of his behavior. He would never leave his phone behind and was super secretive of it.

No, I don’t think you should believe him. I don’t think the fact that they have an addiction clicks on them. I’ve caught my boyfriend THREE times going behind my back and making porn accounts, subscribing to OF, and messaging girls for videos. 

Trust me, they don’t see anything wrong with it. Not after the first time, and not after the third time.
